name: Question 8
problem:
Consider the curve defined parametrically as 

$$
x=2\operatorname{cos}⁡t,\,y={sin}^{2}⁡t,\,t\in [0,\pi ].
$$

What integral gives the surface area generated when this curve is rotated $2\pi $ radians about the $x$-axis?
